main.description: Embedded reference to another post (quoted post)

post.description: Strong reference to the embedded post (includes URI and CID)

view.description: View of a quoted-post embed as served by the AppView, optionally enriched with resolved post data

post.description: Strong reference to the embedded post (includes URI and CID)

resolved.description: Resolved data for the referenced post (e.g., a hydrated Bluesky post), or an unavailable marker with a user-facing message. For a removed Coves subject, the embed resolves to nothing beyond the strongRef: no resolved object, copied body, or media; social.coves.community.post.get on that strongRef returns the tombstone.
